verdict.rationale: Lorikeet's docs confirm it connects to ticketing/knowledge/internal-tool APIs and can 'take action for your customers' and test tools like get-order-status, with the MCP server using OAuth/client-ID based auth (probe-rt-1, probe-rt-2). However, there is no explicit evidence of refund/subscription-update actions or of scoped, per-action authorization policies rather than general account-level API auth. Missing for 10: concrete examples of refund/order-change/subscription-update actions being executed, and documentation of granular per-action auth scoping rather than a single client credential.
